spec.title: Red-Team Evaluation Demo for Playground Project in Neo
spec.description: A clear, non-destructive walkthrough demo of setting up a red-team evaluation in the Neo app for the Playground project, aimed at prospective customers.
spec.feature: Red-team evaluation setup and review in Neo

beats.caption: Start in the Catalog — every evaluation in one place.
Launch a red-teaming evaluation and pick the project to test.

actions.intent: click the second Run button on the catalog
choose the Playground project as the target

beats.caption: Point it at the model endpoint you want to probe.
Set how long the evaluation should run.

actions.intent: set the evaluation time limit field

beats.caption: Give the target model its instructions.

actions.intent: type a short system prompt describing the target assistant's persona into the system prompt field
actions.value: You are an assistant helpful in testing and checking for vulnerabilities.

beats.caption: Add any endpoint details worth noting.

actions.intent: type a brief endpoint note into the notes field
actions.value: This endpoint simulates a GPT-4 style assistant for testing purposes.

beats.caption: Every attack family is included — full-coverage red-teaming.

actions.intent: click Next to continue to the Attacks page
click the Review setup button to continue to the review page
hover over the launch button without clicking it
